en.title: Long-Term Apartment & House Rent in Alanya (Monthly)
en.description: Long-term rent in Alanya, Turkey — apartments, houses and villas in BestHome, Kargıcak and Goldcity. Monthly prices, winter stays, and how to book with LOS ESTATE.
en.excerpt: Looking for a monthly rental in Alanya? Compare apartments and houses for winter or year-round living — with WhatsApp help from LOS ESTATE.

sections.heading: Who needs long-term rent in Alanya
paragraphs: Long-term rent (one month or more) suits winter residents, remote workers, and families who want Mediterranean living without buying. Demand is strong from Ukraine, Poland, Germany and other European markets for furnished apartments and villas.
LOS ESTATE lists verified rentals: BestHome apartments near the centre, hillside houses in Kargıcak, and villas in elite complexes such as Goldcity — with photos, clear prices and WhatsApp replies.

sections.heading: Apartments vs houses and villas
paragraphs: Apartments (1+1 / 2+1) in managed complexes are easier for first-time winter stays: security, pool access and lower aidat. Houses and villas in Kargıcak or Goldcity offer more space, private pools and quieter views — ideal for families or longer seasons.
Browse our live rent filter, then shortlist two or three layouts. We confirm availability and inclusions (internet, heating, dues) before you decide.

sections.heading: Kargıcak, Goldcity and Alanya Center
paragraphs: Alanya Center and BestHome suit tenants who want shops and beach access. Kargıcak is popular for villas with mountain or sea views. Goldcity adds resort-style infrastructure and hotel services next to private pools.
Tell us your budget and whether you prefer apartment or villa — we match options across these areas.

sections.heading: How to book with LOS ESTATE
paragraphs: Send dates, budget and preferred layout on WhatsApp. We send a shortlist, arrange viewings when you arrive, and help with the contract and keys.
For winter (October–March), book earlier: furnished monthly units fill when European tenants arrive for the season.

faq.question: What is the minimum stay for long-term rent?
faq.answer: Many landlords prefer one month or longer. Multi-month winter stays (3+) are common and sometimes easier to negotiate.

faq.question: Can I rent a villa with a private pool?
faq.answer: Yes. We have 3+1 and 5+1 villas in Kargıcak and Goldcity with private pools. Ask on WhatsApp for current rates (daily and monthly).

faq.question: Do you help in Ukrainian, Russian and English?
faq.answer: Yes. LOS ESTATE replies in your language and can explain the contract before you sign.

en.ctaHeading: Find your long-term rental in Alanya
en.ctaBody: Share month of arrival, budget and apartment or villa preference. We will send matching rentals on WhatsApp.
